objective: Improve recognizable player-specific behavior over complete games; exact move accuracy is a guardrail, not the optimization target.

prototype.evidence_status: Development-only architecture comparison. Local players were used in prior v1 work, so the prototype evaluation cannot be presented as fresh independent confirmation.
prototype.time_control_selection: Use the first capacity scenario with at least 20 locally supported players; capacity is label-free and cannot select model settings.

model_comparison.baseline: Frozen population policy plus independently fitted v1 conditional-logit residual.
model_comparison.candidate: Frozen population logits plus a jointly trained player-conditioned legal-move scorer.
model_comparison.selection_rule: On development players only, select the smallest candidate that minimizes equal-player generated identity error while replay style TV improves over the v1 residual and quality guardrails pass.

quality_guardrails: personal NLL no worse than shared
personal exact accuracy no more than 2 percentage points below shared
sampled reference-loss difference versus shared has a 95% upper bound no greater than 1 winning-chance point
evaluation.prototype_gate: On the six fixed prototype evaluation players, personal must beat shared and wrong-player controls on the generated identity composite; use the result only to decide whether to fund the scaled run.
evaluation.promotion_rule: Only the later scaled run may promote the model: on newly acquired untouched confirmation players, personal must beat shared and wrong-player controls on the preregistered generated identity composite with paired-player 95% intervals wholly below zero; replay style TV must also improve and every quality guardrail must pass.
